back to the chapel you just left.","source_id":"GLUE_REFLECTION","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":4},{"text":"That building of glass cost only 40,000 livres to raise, while the relics it was built to shelter cost 135,000, and the great reliquary to hold them another 100,000.","source_id":"GLUE_REFLECTION","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":4},{"text":"In August 1239 two Dominican friars carried those relics from Venice, and for the final stretch Louis himself carried them, barefoot and dressed as a penitent.","source_id":"GLUE_REFLECTION","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":4},{"text":"This little garden takes its name from a pope who fell so hard for Paris that leaving broke his heart.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"He was Angelo Roncalli, born in Lombardy in 1881 and dead in 1963, but before he became the \"good pope\" and the father of the Second Vatican Council of 1962 to 1965, he was the papal nuncio here, from 1944 to 1953.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"Parisians still remember his long walks through the city, trailing friends of every stripe — Protestants, Catholics, Jews, agnostics, atheists.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"\"Jesus came to break down the barriers,\" he preached.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"\"The central point of his teaching is love.\"","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"He read French literature and knew the postwar intellectuals and theologians, the very people he would later invite to help reshape the Church at Vatican II.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"At diplomatic receptions he happily took the champagne and the conviviality of men and women alike.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"A savvy diplomat, he won the trust of the French government, and when President Auriol awarded him the Legion of Honor, he praised Roncalli for respecting \"the traditions of justice and tolerance,\" the honor of the French nation.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"So when Rome recalled him, it stung.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"\"I love France and I love Paris,\" he told a friend, \"and I hoped to stay a little longer. I can't really see myself in Rome.\"","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"This inviting square beneath the flying buttresses is his memorial.","source_id":"4804c107-4afa-41fa-ba8d-c536bd1e9aba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"But the ground was holy long before him.","source_id":"74bb33cc-f917-4c4a-bbc8-e231ae3da281","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"Until 1831, when a riot destroyed it, the palace of the archbishop of Paris stood right here, between the cathedral and the Seine.","source_id":"74bb33cc-f917-4c4a-bbc8-e231ae3da281","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"The site's religious pull runs back to the fourth century, when Emperor Julian presided over a temple to Jupiter, and those Roman ruins became the foundation of the basilica of Saint-Etienne in 528 and then the first Notre-Dame.","source_id":"74bb33cc-f917-4c4a-bbc8-e231ae3da281","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"The cathedral you see now was begun in 1163, and after centuries of renovation and the fanatical rampages of the Terror, it stands as one of the crown jewels of Gothic architecture across all of Europe.","source_id":"74bb33cc-f917-4c4a-bbc8-e231ae3da281","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"Beneath the parvis out front, a crypt still holds Gallo-Roman walls, a quay, a hypocaust, and medieval cellars — two thousand years of history stacked underground.","source_id":"5d623963-0d7e-4e49-8502-b860966286bf","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"And close by stands the Hotel-Dieu, the oldest hospital in Paris, founded around 651.","source_id":"3e9bade2-1d10-486b-8dba-b8e629348fd6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"If the crowds inside the cathedral get to be too much, you're in good company wanting quiet.","source_id":"2f152eb7-9030-4161-b5f6-f774f20764aa","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"Henry James's Lambert Strether, the protagonist of The Ambassadors, slipped alone into \"the great dim church\" and felt its \"beneficent action on his nerves,\" a place of refuge with \"a sense of safety, of simplification.\"","source_id":"2f152eb7-9030-4161-b5f6-f774f20764aa","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"Out here the mood is often gentler than the interior, where you'll almost certainly get stuck behind a crush of tourists aiming cameras at the stained glass.","source_id":"9e56fdb8-7edb-4f7b-a5fb-fd9a69a26705","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"In April the cherry trees bloom along the south porches, screening but never quite hiding the original medallions carved with scenes of student life.","source_id":"9e56fdb8-7edb-4f7b-a5fb-fd9a69a26705","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4},{"text":"Beds of daffodils and tulips run the length of the cathedral's southern flank to the eastern end, where the flying buttresses rise over a small square generous with flowers, benches, and travelers taking their ease.","source_id":"9e56fdb8-7edb-4f7b-a5fb-fd9a69a26705","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":4}]}
